info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Hotel Rooms Inventorys-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Rooms Inventory API provides access to the available rooms within a hotel, allowing consumers to easily view and manage room inventories. This API supports operations that retrieve detailed information about room types, availability, and inventory status, making it essential for hotel management software and booking platforms. Typical users include hotel operators, booking agents, and travel application developers who need to integrate room inventory data into their services. With this API, stakeholders can ensure accurate inventory representation and optimize room allocation strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve the current inventory of rooms.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access the current inventory of rooms. It provides information about available rooms, their statuses, and any relevant details that can aid in room management and bookings.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving room inventory. This body may include various parameters to filter or specify the inventory results.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the inventory of rooms.
